arguments.intent: Compose an aesthetic prompt pack for six cohesive cinematic storyboard stills illustrating The Cosmic Body: One Purusha, Four Functions. Source argument: guṇa mixture takes a mold through karma; a fitted function acquires value through contribution; teaching, protection, exchange and skilled labor sustain one shared life. Use a bronze hinge, a doorway, and one shared architectural dwelling to connect these meanings, rather than a prone statue with glowing circuit lines. Six beats: (1) macro hinge casting in a precisely fitted mold; (2) cropped hands transmitting a usable working drawing, receiver continuing it; (3) forearms securing a doorway brace, sheltering the work behind it; (4) grain poured from one vessel into another, exchange as provision; (5) grounded craftsperson hands seating the same hinge pin, door bearing weight; (6) doorway opening to reveal the connected workstations, a restrained anatomical correspondence in the overall architecture. Current Noesis V3 brand: precise but playful, anatomical at visionary scale, inhabitation and integration, organic internally sourced light, real load-bearing structures, Void Black #070B1D, Parchment #F0EDE3 fine engraved detail, restrained Sacred Gold #C5A017, small Coherence Emerald #10B5A7 resolution. Cinematic designed cutaway with tactile paper, bronze, timber and worked-material textures; deliberate depth and negative space. No faces, no sunlit lifestyle, no caste costumes or ranked social levels, no corpse or sarcophagus, no steampunk, no tron-lines, no wireframe hologram, no drifting particles, no cosmic wallpaper, no decorative mandalas, no text generated into image. Shared hinge design and doorway, same camera axis and architectural proportions across the sequence. Pull actual relevant techniques and aesthetic references, explain how they improve composition, material contrast and semantic readability. Preserve these brand and source constraints instead of replacing them with retrieved generic fantasy or website layouts. Return paste-ready IMAGE prompt direction and source lineage; do not imply aesthetic retrieval proves human acceptance.
